items.title: Kristallnacht' 88th anniversary: Merz says Germany faces historic test over antisemitism
items.desc: It has been 88 years since "Kristallnacht", the "Night of Broken Glass" in Europe, a violent pogrom against the Jewish population across Nazi Germany and Austria, marking a critical escalation toward the Holocaust. Friedrich Merz, Federal Chancellor of Germany, said that Germany currently faces a historic test over antisemitism.

items.title: US Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth calls impeachment moves 'a farce'
items.desc: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday, November 10, called an effort to impeach him over ​abuse of power in the Iran war a farce and sabotage that plays into the hands of adversaries. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Commentator Douglas Herbert has more.

items.title: Who exactly is Pete Hegseth, the Pentagon chief facing an impeachment bid?
items.desc: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday dismissed the impeachment effort against him as "a political spectacle". He made the comments a day after Republican Thomas Massie launched a bid to impeach him over his handling of the unpopular war in Iran and other actions. But who is Pete Hegseth? A former Fox News host and military veteran, he has become one of the most prominent figures in the Trump administration.

items.title: French students vow to keep up protest pressure for better learning conditions
items.desc: France has been buffeted for months by street protests. They began in September ​with students ‌demanding the renovation of school buildings, more teachers and ⁠university reforms but then turned into broader cost-of-living protests, drawing in trade unions and political activists, and sometimes ‌turning violent.

items.title: Pope Leo XIV visits Argentina in second leg of Latin American tour
items.desc: Pope Leo XIV visited Argentina on the second leg of his South American tour, following a stop in Uruguay. During his visit, he celebrated public Masses, met with the faithful and held talks with religious and government leaders. Peru is the final stop on the pontiff's tour.

items.title: REPLAY: US Secretary of State Rubio holds press conference after G7 meeting
items.desc: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio talked to the press Tuesday as the G7 meets in Paris. He said he saw no need to resume major combat operations against Iran because economic restrictions were working so effectively. He also hailed US-mediated talks between Russia and Ukraine in Abu Dhabi as "very productive" and said the discussions should be expanded to include Europeans at the table.

items.title: French far right on track to secure €10 million loan for Le Pen's presidential campaign
items.desc: France's far-right National Rally party on Tuesday reached a preliminary agreement with two European banks for a loan to help fund Marine Le Pen's presidential campaign. The lenders are expected to finalise the €10 million loan by the end of the month.

items.title: REPLAY: Pentagon chief Hegseth holds news briefing amid impeachment push
items.desc: US ​Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday called ​moves to impeach him over abuse of power in the Iran war a "farce" that ​would ‌fail. Hegseth made the comment ⁠at a news conference – his first since May – a day after US Representative ‌Thomas Massie, a Kentucky Republican, introduced eight ⁠articles of impeachment against him. Watch our replay.

items.title: G7 talks in Paris try to tackle global crises with uncertainty high over US approach
items.desc: Top diplomats from the Group of Seven industrialized democracies gathered in Paris on Monday with clear differences on global crises and questions about how U.S. President Donald Trump will approach foreign policy after his Republican Party’s heavy losses in the midterm elections. Whether on the Russia-Ukraine war, Iran or the International Criminal Court, the sides appeared far apart as two days of talks got underway, as FRANCE 24's Clovis Casali reports.

items.title: ‘It’s a farce’: Hegseth slams impeachment effort
items.desc: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth dismissed a move to impeach him by a Republican lawmaker as a “farce” and a political “stunt” on Tuesday. It came a day after outgoing US Representative Thomas Massie introduced eight articles of impeachment against Hegseth over his handling of the war with Iran and other alleged abuses of power.

items.title: The robot boom: Are businesses ready for an AI
items.desc: As artificial intelligence makes machines more capable and autonomous, businesses are racing to embrace robotics. But while many executives expect to deploy robot fleets in the coming years, far fewer have a clear strategy for doing so. FRANCE 24's Charles Pellegrin speaks to John Healy, Intel's Vice President of Robotics and Industrial Solutions, about the opportunities, risks and workforce challenges behind the growing robot revolution.

items.title: Israel live: Netanyahu bloc targets Arab lawmakers as new parliament is sworn in
items.desc: Tensions ran high at the first session of Israel's new parliament on Tuesday as rival camps traded barbs over the possibility of ruling with the support of Arab lists. The party of opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot, who has been tasked with forming a government, moved to immediately set up a commission to investigate Hamas's October 7, 2023 attack, an action long resisted by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Follow our live coverage for the latest updates.

items.title: 'Clean beauty': How to navigate the latest cosmetic and skincare trends
items.desc: It's hard to believe, but Christmas is just six weeks away. That means the battle of the Advent calendars is now well and truly underway. So if you love beauty products but are wanting to buy with safety and a healthy approach in mind, what do you do? Joining us from Atlanta is Lisa Fennessy, the founder and CEO of The New Knew, which reviews "clean beauty" products. She tells us what to look out for to take better care of our skin.

items.title: Pokemon's 30-year anniversary: Japanese cards sell like wildfire
items.desc: Pokemon, the famous Japanese little monsters, are turning 30, and their trading cards are selling like wildfire, often being flipped for small fortunes. People prepared to camp outside specialised shops in a bid to buy some of these cards.

items.title: Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth calls move to impeach him 'sabotage'
items.desc: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday called ​moves to impeach him over abuse of power in the Iran war a "farce" that ​would ‌fail. The Pentagon chief slammed the move as a "political spectacle" by an outgoing congressional opponent of President Donald Trump, who said Hegseth deserved "an 'A' plus" for his performance.

items.title: US-mediated talks on ending Russia-Ukraine war begin in Abu Dhabi
items.desc: Three-way talks between Russia, Ukraine and the US opened Tuesday, November 10, in the United Arab Emirates, as Washington made another push to end the war. The two-day session in Abu Dhabi is the first such meeting since February. It will focus on establishing future security guarantees for the warring countries.

items.title: French students block dozens of schools, vow more protests
items.desc: French students blocked the entrances to dozens of high schools on Tuesday, November 10, as they kept up protests for better learning conditions. These protests across France have spiraled into larger cost-of-living demonstrations in recent weeks, some marked by violence and police brutality. FRANCE 24's Luke Shrago reports from the ground.

items.title: Ukraine peace talks: Who is sitting at the negotiating table
items.desc: Three-way talks between Russia, Ukraine and the United States opened Tuesday in the United Arab Emirates, as Washington made a renewed push to end the war that followed Moscow's invasion of its neighbour nearly five years ago. As these two days of talks in Abu Dhabi get underway, the negotiators that each country has chosen to send tell us most of what we need to know about what will be discussed, as FRANCE 24's International Affairs Commentator Douglas Herbert explains.

items.title: Dana White: UFC chief declines Trump’s White House job offer
items.desc: Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) chief Dana White made a surprise appearance at the White House on Monday to turn down Donald Trump’s offer of a job as the White House press secretary, saying he has “zero political aspirations”. Trump stunned the world on November 7 when he said on social media that he had offered White the job, only to claim a day later that he was "only kidding”.

items.title: New Israel parliament to be sworn in as Eisenkot works to form new govt
items.desc: Israel's new parliament will be sworn on Tuesday, November 10, with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu set to lose his majority as rival Gadi Eisenkot works to form a new government. The opposition hopes to use its newfound legislative power to move quickly on key priorities, including a commission to investigate security failures under Netanyahu that allowed the October 7, 2023 attack by Hamas. FRANCE 24's correspondent in Jerusalem Noga Tarnopolsky has more.

items.title: California voters reject measure to tax the wealth of billionaires
items.desc: California voters have rejected a first-in-the-nation tax on the net worth of billionaires following a contentious ballot fight that generated huge spending by some prominent tech leaders eager to stop their taxes from going up. The measure would have imposed a one-time 5% tax on the wealth of Californians whose net worth exceeds $1 billion. FRANCE 24's correspondent in Los Angeles Loic Pialat has more.

items.title: 【专题报道】从一部手机到一间AI课堂：联合国与传音携手推动非洲儿童和难民的数字包容
items.desc: 数字化正在深刻改变全球发展格局，但在许多发展中国家，仍有大量人口尚未接入互联网。如何让技术创新惠及低收入和弱势群体，成为企业社会责任领域的重要议题。《联合国新闻》记者张静近日走访位于深圳的传音公司总部，与该公司联合创始人、董事阿里夫围绕数字包容与企业社会责任展开对话。

items.title: COP31在安塔利亚开幕：气候承诺能否转化为实际行动？
items.desc: 近200个国家的代表周一齐聚土耳其海滨城市安塔利亚，出席第31届联合国气候变化大会（COP31）。本届大会着重推动落实既有承诺，力求在减排、气候融资、清洁能源和保护脆弱社区等议题上取得进展。
